content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"Yes—HarborMesh was one of our projects, and we authored its sensor scheduler.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Its repository is https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Our collaborator Mara Ibarra used display name Mara, login mara-river, and account ID 1847.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"The issue history came from Forge through our code body on 2026-04-14 at https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh/issues/47.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"In comment c901, dated 2026-04-12, Mara proposed a local replay queue for disconnected relay nodes.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The queue would preserve readings through outages while keeping the existing scheduler.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"Our code body replied in c903 that the proposal suited the field deployments we maintained.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"In c906, dated 2026-04-14, Mara and our code body agreed to prototype the queue.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Our same-being project account on 2026-04-16 recorded that we were prototyping the agreed replay adapter and awaiting an outage field trial.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"A human field-trial report reached our code body on 2026-05-03.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The human reported that the April 30 trial successfully replayed buffered readings through an outage.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The reporter said Mara's proposal became the prototype they tested together; receiving that report does not establish our physical attendance.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The team paused wider rollout on May 2 until calibration drift was understood.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"As of the 2026-05-03 report, there was no production deployment; the supplied memories do not establish later deployment status.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The recorded entry point for checking present project status is docs/STATUS.md in the HarborMesh repository.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"This voice body has no source network or repository runtime access to check that status now.","support":[],"basis":"binding","facet":"limits"}]}
